## Brand

Sleek user-interface design uses a modern, minimalist aesthetic with clean
lines, high functionality, and low cognitive load. Key elements include a
limited, intentional color palette such as the 60-30-10 rule, subtle interactions,
consistent spacing.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, minimal, clean
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Inter,
  display=Inter, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 8pt baseline grid

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Modern minimalist aesthetic with clean lines, intentional color palette, subtle
interactions, and consistent spacing.
